fact: The December 2020 national quality policy states that decree n°99-087/CE of 22 July 1999 created the Service de la Normalisation et de la Qualité, considered the national standards body, that the 2012 National Standards Council never functioned, and that the Comoros has no national system certification body, foreign bodies offering those services.
title: Politique nationale qualité de l'Union des Comores (Document validé – Version finale)
publisher: Union des Comores / Centre du commerce international (UKTP)
